title: MCMultiplayer
description: A mod for seamless multiplayer that adds a one-click UPnP WAN server creation directly from the ESC menu, built-in IP tools, and advanced host controls.
body:
A mod for seamless multiplayer play with friends. It automatically detects and displays your local and global IP addresses, allows quick clipboard copying via hotkeys, and features a one-click WAN server creation directly from the ESC pause menu using native UPnP port mapping. Additionally includes built-in advanced server host tools for banning and pardoning players by username and IP address.
